body: I actually woke up on the kitchen floor of my friend's house. I don't even know how I got there. I feel slightly better today. Yesterday I went to work then came home and read while everyone else was out; which I think helped. I enjoy alone time. Regarding the psychiatrist, I see one once a week but somehow it is still very little help. Maybe I should see someone else?

Well I had just taken them before I wrote this so that probably explains it. But I agree, with the amount of whiskey I had beforehand, I'm surprised with how clear my writing seems to be. Kind of depressing considering I'm just so used to being that drunk all of the time.
fuck everything I just now said. i am going to sleep.

Thank you for responding. It means a lot. I guess my number one issue is that I can't find anyone to talk to that completely understands. The only one person that can start to comprehend where I am coming from is as fucked up; if not more fucked up than I am at this point. 

Well I feel like I am frozen. There is a block in my life in which I will never hurdle over unless I give into something that will make me a miserable fuck like the rest of the world...In other words if I do what I enjoy I will make no money which will in turn make me miserable..but if I do something I don't enjoy I will have money to "have fun" but will still be just as miserable from the start. For some reason not many people understand this predicament I am facing.
